newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-AUSTRIA'S RIEDL NEW LIECHTENSTEIN COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIA'S RIEDL NEW LIECHTENSTEIN COACH.

text.p: Austria's Alfred Riedl was named on Tuesday to replace Dietrich Weise as Liechtenstein soccer coach.
Riedl, coach of the Austrian national squad from 1990 to 1992, takes over from Weise who resigned following an 11-1 loss to Macedonia in a World Cup qualifier in November.
The former Austria international played for first division clubs in Austria, Belgium and France before retiring in 1985.
Riedl has spent much of his coaching career in Morocco, Eygpt and United Arab Emirates. He was manager of Iran before joining Liechtenstein.
Liechtenstein's team of part-timers have lost all four of their World Cup matches, conceding 21 goals while scoring just twice.
